entities.summary: Ruxanda Glavan is a Moldovan politician, who since 30 July 2015 until 25 July 2017 served as Minister of Health of Moldova. Previously, since 18 February 2015 until 30 July 2015 she served as Minister of Labour, Social Protection and Family of Moldova. Between 2013-2015 Ruxanda Glavan was Deputy Minister of Labour, Social Protection and Family.
